It is an exact replica of the Russian era version of the Big Muff Pi, featuring 2N5089 transistors. The kit includes metal film resistors and metallized polyester film capacitors, which deliver vintage tone with reduced noise compared to the original. Despite its small size, the Li’l Beaver uses all through-hole components and panel mounted hardware. It also features true bypass functionality. The Li’l Beaver comes in various versions, each with its own unique characteristics. These versions include the “Standard” version, which is the basic version of the pedal with no additional modifications. The “Modded” version includes additional modifications to the circuit, providing different tonal options and versatility. The “Vintage” version is designed to replicate the sound and feel of the original vintage Big Muff Pi, with components and circuitry that closely resemble the original.
